title: Problem selector ignores the common-problems filter
reasoning: The selector builds its options without filter settings and only updates when selected runs change. The chart applies common_problems_only to its context. Consequently, enabling that filter leaves problems available for selection that the chart's context excludes. The exact empty-chart behavior depends on the unseen chart builder, but the mismatch between selectable problems and chart data is visible here.
reproduction: Select two runs with overlapping but different problem sets, enable common_problems_only, and select a problem present in only one run. The selector still offers that problem while the chart receives the filtered context.
recommendation: Make the options callback depend on filter-settings-store and apply the same problem filtering as the chart. Clear or reconcile the selected value when it is excluded.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover scatter aggregation with missing time and scatter catalog naming; neither exercises problem selector callbacks or filter changes.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise selector and chart callbacks across changes to selected runs and common_problems_only, asserting that selectable problems match the filtered context and that excluded selections are reconciled.
minimumFixScope: src/slop_code/dashboard/pages/problem_comparison.py and behavioral coverage for its selector/filter interaction
